idle_side.prompt: Stands still in a relaxed pose; its body rises and falls very slightly and its tail sways a little. It stays in place, facing right.

walk_side.prompt: Walks in place: its legs step one after the other, its body bobs gently with each step and its tail sways. It stays in place, facing right.

run_side.prompt: Runs in place with long fast strides, its body leaning forward and its tail held straight out behind. It stays in place, facing right.

eat_side.prompt: Lowers its head to the ground, eats the grass with a few bites, then lifts its head back up. It stays in place, facing right.
